1: import type { Client, TextChannel, User } from 'discord.js';
2: import { getDb } from '../db/index.js';
3: import { digestLog, type ListingRow, type ServerRow } from '../db/schema.js';
4: import { DIGEST_SECTION_CAP } from '../utils/constants.js';
5: import type { DigestTrigger } from '../types/index.js';
6: import { digestLine } from '../utils/embeds.js';
7: import { prepareDigestListings, setServerWatermark } from './digest-state.js';
8: import { sendCriticalAlert } from './alerts.js';
9: import { retryWithBackoff } from '../utils/retry.js';
10: 
11: const now = () => Date.now();
12: 
13: export interface DigestResult {
14:   sent: boolean;
15:   channelOk: boolean;
16:   dmOk: boolean;
17:   listingCount: number;
18: }
19: 
20: /**
21:  * Format a digest message body from the collected listings, grouped by type.
22:  * Each section is capped and overflows are noted.
23:  */
24: export function formatDigest(listingsToShow: ListingRow[]): string {
25:   const groups = {
26:     have: listingsToShow.filter((l) => l.intent === 'have'),
27:     want: listingsToShow.filter((l) => l.intent === 'want'),
28:   };
29: 
30:   const sections: string[] = [];
31:   const pushSection = (title: string, rows: ListingRow[]): void => {
32:     if (rows.length === 0) {
33:       return;
34:     }
35:     const shown = rows.slice(0, DIGEST_SECTION_CAP);
36:     const lines = shown.map(digestLine).join('\n');
37:     const overflow =
38:       rows.length > DIGEST_SECTION_CAP ? `\n+${rows.length - DIGEST_SECTION_CAP} more` : '';
39:     sections.push(`${title} (${rows.length})\n${lines}${overflow}`);
40:   };
41: 
42:   pushSection('NEW HAVES', groups.have);
43:   pushSection('NEW WANTS', groups.want);
44: 
45:   return sections.join('\n\n');
46: }
47: 
48: /**
49:  * Run a digest for one server. Follows the watermark rules in the spec: only
50:  * listings created after `last_digest_at` are selected, delivery is by
51:  * `digest_mode`, and the watermark only advances when at least one destination
52:  * succeeds.
53:  */
54: export async function runDigest(
55:   client: Client,
56:   server: ServerRow,
57:   trigger: DigestTrigger,
58: ): Promise<DigestResult> {
59:   const collected = prepareDigestListings(server);
60: 
61:   const empty: DigestResult = { sent: false, channelOk: false, dmOk: false, listingCount: 0 };
62:   if (collected.length === 0) {
63:     return empty;
64:   }
65: 
66:   const heading = `Daily Listing Digest — ${new Date(now()).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
67:     year: 'numeric',
68:     month: 'long',
69:     day: 'numeric',
70:   })}`;
71:   const message = `${heading}\n\n${formatDigest(collected)}`;
72: 
73:   let channelOk = false;
74:   let dmOk = false;
75:   if (server.digestMode === 'channel' || server.digestMode === 'both') {
76:     channelOk = await deliverToChannel(client, server, message);
77:   }
78:   if (server.digestMode === 'dm' || server.digestMode === 'both') {
79:     dmOk = await deliverToDm(client, server, message);
80:   }
81: 
82:   if (!channelOk && !dmOk) {
83:     // No destination succeeded; record the failure and leave the watermark
84:     // unchanged so the same listings are retried next time.
85:     logDigest(server.id, trigger, collected, { channel: false, dm: false });
86:     sendCriticalAlert(`Digest delivery failed for server ${server.id}`);
87:     return { sent: false, channelOk, dmOk, listingCount: collected.length };
88:   }
89: 
90:   setServerWatermark(server.id, now());
91:   logDigest(server.id, trigger, collected, { channel: channelOk, dm: dmOk });
92:   return { sent: true, channelOk, dmOk, listingCount: collected.length };
93: }
94: 
95: async function deliverToChannel(
96:   client: Client,
97:   server: ServerRow,
98:   message: string,
99: ): Promise<boolean> {
100:   if (!server.adminChannelId) {
101:     return false;
102:   }
103:   try {
104:     const channel = (await client.channels.fetch(server.adminChannelId)) as TextChannel | null;
105:     if (!channel || !channel.isTextBased() || !channel.isSendable()) {
106:       return false;
107:     }
108:     await retryWithBackoff(
109:       () => channel.send({ content: message, allowedMentions: { parse: [] } }),
110:       {
111:         attempts: 3,
112:         baseDelayMs: 1000,
113:         maxDelayMs: 8000,
114:       },
115:     );
116:     return true;
117:   } catch {
118:     return false;
119:   }
120: }
121: 
122: async function deliverToDm(client: Client, server: ServerRow, message: string): Promise<boolean> {
123:   if (!server.digestDmUserId) {
124:     return false;
125:   }
126:   try {
127:     const user = (await client.users.fetch(server.digestDmUserId)) as User | null;
128:     if (!user) {
129:       return false;
130:     }
131:     await retryWithBackoff(() => user.send({ content: message, allowedMentions: { parse: [] } }), {
132:       attempts: 3,
133:       baseDelayMs: 1000,
134:       maxDelayMs: 8000,
135:     });
136:     return true;
137:   } catch {
138:     return false;
139:   }
140: }
141: 
142: function logDigest(
143:   serverId: string,
144:   trigger: DigestTrigger,
145:   included: ListingRow[],
146:   results: { channel: boolean; dm: boolean },
147: ): void {
148:   const db = getDb();
149:   db.insert(digestLog)
150:     .values({
151:       serverId,
152:       sentAt: now(),
153:       trigger,
154:       listingCount: included.length,
155:       listingIdsIncluded: JSON.stringify(included.map((l) => l.id)),
156:       deliveryResults: JSON.stringify(results),
157:     })
158:     .run();
159: }
